course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice giving simple opinions with tycker att in an everyday discussion.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Colleagues react to a cafe, TV show, event, or lunch option.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Expressing and responding to opinions politely.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a familiar everyday topic and exchange mild opinions without arguing.

main_focus.name: opinions with tycker att
main_focus.description: Use tycker att to state an opinion, with correct subordinate clause word order when needed.
model_examples: Jag tycker att det nya kaféet är mysigt.
Tycker du att serien är bättre nu?
main_focus.desired_presence: Use tycker att naturally 3-4 times as the main opinion structure.

useful_chunks: Jag är inte säker på det.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use opinion chunks as turn-taking language, not as isolated grammar examples.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker introduces a familiar topic and gives a first opinion.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare impressions and agree or disagree gently.
dialogue_shape.ending: They settle on a shared view or leave room for a different preference.

focus: which option or view is preferred and why
whether the conversation ends in agreement or polite uncertainty

sentence_focus: one sentence agreeing with an opinion
one sentence comparing two everyday options
one sentence combining an opinion with a reason
